name: MonarchSubscriptionsTable
title: SubscriptionsTable
wrapsNative: VStack rows at compact width and Grid columns at regular width, with Button rows, MonarchMoney, MonarchStatusBadge and MonarchEmptyState
summary: A list of recurring agreements with name and plan, customer, status, price per billing period, normalised monthly amount and renewal: stacked rows on a phone and columns at regular width.
whenToUse: A customer's or a workspace's subscriptions in a billing screen, where each row may open the subscription.
whenNotToUse: For one subscription's details, use LabeledContent with the .monarch style. For plans to choose from, use MonarchPricingTable. For general tabular data with sorting and selection, use SwiftUI Table.
api: init(_ subscriptions: [MonarchSubscription], registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = nil, locale: Locale? = nil, isCustomerShown: Bool = true, isMonthlyShown: Bool? = nil, labels: MonarchSubscriptionsTableLabels = MonarchSubscriptionsTableLabels(), onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchSubscription) -> Void)? = nil)

MonarchSubscription.init(_ id: String, name: String, plan: String? = nil, quantity: Int = 1, customer: String? = nil, status: String, amount: Decimal?, currencyCode: String, interval: MonarchSubscriptionInterval? = .month, intervalCount: Int = 1, monthly: MonarchSubscriptionMonthly? = nil, renewalDate: Date? = nil, renewsAutomatically: Bool = true, cancelsAt: Date? = nil, changesAt: Date? = nil)
enum MonarchSubscriptionInterval { case day, week, month, year }
enum MonarchSubscriptionMonthly { case amount(Decimal, currencyCode: String), notConverted }

MonarchSubscriptionsTableLabels.init(caption: String? = nil, subscription: String? = nil, customer: String? = nil, status: String? = nil, price: String? = nil, monthly: String? = nil, renewal: String? = nil, customPrice: String? = nil, quantity: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, interval: (@Sendable (MonarchSubscriptionInterval?, Int) -> String)? = nil, priceSuffix: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, spokenPrice: (@Sendable (String, String) -> String)? = nil, spokenOneTimePrice: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, cancels: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, changes: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, renews: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, ends: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, evergreen: String? = nil, notConverted: String? = nil, notConvertedHint: String? = nil, noValue: String? = nil, emptyTitle: String? = nil, emptyMessage: String? = nil)

options.name: subscriptions
options.description: The rows, in display order. Empty shows the empty state.

options.name: registry
options.description: Statuses that add to or replace the built-in subscription statuses (MonarchSubscriptionsTable.statuses).

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts and dates. Default: the environment's; dates use the environment's time zone.

options.name: isCustomerShown
options.description: Shows the customer column (or the customer before the renewal in stacked rows). Turn it off on one customer's screen.

options.name: isMonthlyShown
options.description: Shows the monthly column at regular width. nil: when any row has a monthly figure.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the billing period words and the spoken price.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Opens a subscription. Each row becomes a button; stacked rows get a chevron and table names use the link colour.

states.name: stacked rows
states.description: At compact width and at the accessibility sizes: name and price with its period, the plan line, the customer and renewal, then the status badge. The monthly column is not shown, as on the web below 48rem.

states.name: table
states.description: At regular width: Subscription, Customer, Status, Price, Monthly and Renewal columns with numbers aligned to the trailing edge.

states.name: selectable
states.description: With onSelect each row is a plain button with a 44-point touch target.

states.name: not converted
states.description: An active or past-due row whose monthly figure could not be converted shows "Not converted" with a spoken hint; other rows show a dash.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState at the small size: "No subscriptions" and "Subscriptions appear here once they are created.".

appearance: Names use the strong body style in the default text colour, or the link colour when rows open subscriptions in the table; plan, renewal, headings and period suffixes use the caption style in the muted text colour; rows are separated by dividers in the subtle border colour. Statuses are status badges with their tone's subtle fill. Every colour is a theme role, so the table reads in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web SubscriptionsTable is an HTML table with container queries and link rendering. On iOS rows are a stack at compact width and a Grid at regular width rather than SwiftUI Table, because Table is a scrolling container that cannot sit inside a screen's ScrollView with other content and collapses to one column on iPhone; the plan named List rows and Table, and this was changed for the same reason. Links (href, renderLink) become onSelect, which the app uses for navigation. Amounts are Decimal in major units; minorUnits is not offered. Dates are Date values written in the locale and the environment's time zone; there is no timeZone parameter. The relative-time dependency of the plan is not used: renewal dates are absolute, as on the web. The caption is the table's spoken name only (labels.caption). Android ships the same MonarchSubscriptionsTable.
accessibility: The table is a container named "Subscriptions".

Each subscription is one element read as its name, plan line, customer, status, spoken price ("$49.00 per month"), monthly figure and renewal, in both layouts; the column headings are hidden because each row names its values.
With onSelect each row is a button; activating it calls onSelect.
"Not converted" rows have a hint that explains why the figure is missing.
Statuses are read by their words and drawn with an icon, so they never depend on colour.
A missing amount is read as "No amount".
Rows wrap at every Dynamic Type size and switch to stacked rows at the accessibility sizes; selectable rows keep a 44-point touch target.
edgeCases: An unknown status key shows the neutral unknown look with a label made from the key.
A quantity of 1 or less is not shown.
An intervalCount below 1 is treated as 1; 3 months is written as "quarter".
Nothing is converted between currencies or summed.
The billing period words are English singular and plural strings; languages with other plural rules replace them with labels.interval.

examples.title: Across customers
examples.template:
MonarchSubscriptionsTable(
    [
        MonarchSubscription(
            "s1",
            name: {{subscriptions.0.name}},
            plan: {{subscriptions.0.plan}},
            quantity: {{subscriptions.0.quantity}},
            customer: {{subscriptions.0.customer}},
            status: {{subscriptions.0.status}},
            amount: {{subscriptions.0.amount}} / 100,
            currencyCode: {{subscriptions.0.currency}},
            interval: {{subscriptions.0.interval|case}},
            monthly: .amount({{subscriptions.0.monthly.amount}} / 100, currencyCode: {{subscriptions.0.monthly.currency}}),
            renewalDate: {{subscriptions.0.renewalDate|date}}
        ),
        MonarchSubscription(
            "s2",
            name: {{subscriptions.1.name}},
            plan: {{subscriptions.1.plan}},
            customer: {{subscriptions.1.customer}},
            status: {{subscriptions.1.status}},
            amount: {{subscriptions.1.amount}} / 100,
            currencyCode: {{subscriptions.1.currency}},
            interval: {{subscriptions.1.interval|case}},
            monthly: .notConverted,
            renewalDate: {{subscriptions.1.renewalDate|date}},
            renewsAutomatically: {{subscriptions.1.autoRenew}}
        ),
        MonarchSubscription(
            "s3",
            name: {{subscriptions.2.name}},
            customer: {{subscriptions.2.customer}},
            status: {{subscriptions.2.status}},
            amount: {{subscriptions.2.amount}} / 100,
            currencyCode: {{subscriptions.2.currency}},
            interval: {{subscriptions.2.interval|case}},
            intervalCount: {{subscriptions.2.intervalCount}},
            monthly: .amount({{subscriptions.2.monthly.amount}} / 100, currencyCode: {{subscriptions.2.monthly.currency}}),
            cancelsAt: {{subscriptions.2.cancelAt|date}}
        ),
    ],
    locale: Locale(identifier: {{locale}})
)
.environment(\.timeZone, TimeZone(identifier: {{timeZone}})!)

examples.title: One customer's subscriptions with the app's own statuses
examples.code:
MonarchSubscriptionsTable(
    [MonarchSubscription("sub_9", name: "Archive storage", status: "grace", amount: 5, currencyCode: "USD", interval: .month)],
    registry: MonarchStatusRegistry(["grace": MonarchStatusDefinition("Grace period", tone: .warning)]),
    isCustomerShown: false
)
